To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

• Counterfeit plant protection products are unknown mixtures with unknown effects • The illegal trade of counterfeit plant protection products generates several billion Euro in revenue worldwide • The illegal trade is very hard to detect and to control • There is a high potential for harm to humans, animals and the environment • There is a lack of awareness and a lack of resources for the control of counterfeit products in the private and public sector.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the illegal trade of counterfeit pesticides and the associated risks.
the illegal trade of pesticides and the related criminal offenses in Germany.
the illegal trade of counterfeit plant protection products in Europe.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the illegal trade of counterfeits in plant protection products is an ongoing problem.
the illegal trade of counterfeit plant protection products is an important issue and a highly profitable way of smuggling chemicals.
there are no comprehensive and detailed conclusive statements on the problem of the illegal trade of pesticides.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the illegal trade of pesticides is a global problem and that it is very difficult to detect and to quantify.
there is a need for more information, more exchange of findings and more coordination between the public and private stakeholders.
we have been able to show that the illegal trade in plant protection products is an ongoing and profitable business.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the illegal trade of pesticides is a global problem that needs to be tackled on all levels and that there are a variety of ways to do so.
illegal trade of plant products is a global problem that needs to be tackled on an international level.
illegal plant protection products are a global problem and that the EU is not an island in the fight against this problem.
